name: Data Frame Docks
briefing: The Crew Log docks as a data frame: 1,277 rows and 24 columns. Before you count anything, find out what one row is.

log.title: Entry 3: Missions, not people
log.text: 1,277 rows but only 564 astronauts: each row is one person on one mission. 202 people flew once; Jerry Ross and Franklin Chang-Diaz flew seven times each.
